## Summary
Implements **P10.2 — the detector catalog** (`docs/tickets/P10.2__detector-catalog.md`), the concrete data payload that turns the P10.1 task-coordination engine into a working research queue.

- The **full §33.2 catalog**: all 34 task types, each registered against P10.1's DSL (`tasks.spec`) with a versioned `detector` query and a **testable** `closing_condition`. Registration goes through the SIG-TASK-002 gate, so a successful `build_catalog()` is itself the proof that no row is a "research this" placeholder (SIG-TASK-003).
- The **§31 contradiction → task map** (`CONTRADICTION_TASK_MAP`): every member of the §31 `contradiction_type` vocabulary routes to a catalog task, so a live contradiction always surfaces as actionable work (SIG-TASK-004). Many-to-one by design (the catalog is coarser than the §31 vocabulary) and cross-checked against `reconcile.model.CONTRADICTION_TYPES` — a **test-only** import, so no new runtime dependency on `tasks`.
- **Per-type fixtures** (all 34): each detector fires on a seeded positive, stays quiet on a seeded negative, and **auto-invalidates** through the P10.1 `TaskPool` when its condition clears (SIG-TASK-006).

Implements spec: `docs/tickets/P10.2__detector-catalog.md` (§33.2, §31). Deviations recorded in **ADR-040**.

## What changed
- `tasks/src/tasks/catalog.py` — new: `CATALOG_TASK_TYPES` (34, §33.2 order), `CATALOG_SIZE`, `build_catalog()`, `CONTRADICTION_TASK_MAP`.
- `tasks/src/tasks/__init__.py` — package docstring notes the new module.
- `tests/tasks/test_tasks_catalog.py` — new: count-authority, registration, per-type detector/closing/auto-invalidation fixtures, and the SIG-TASK-004 map completeness tests.
- `docs/adr/ADR-040-*.md` (+ README index), `docs/traceability.md` (P10.2 block), `docs/risk_register.md` (P10.2 block, RISK-P10-09..14).

## Design decisions
- `detector`/`closing_condition` read documented in-memory `Facts` keys, not the live graph — continuing ADR-039's scaffolding boundary (RISK-P10-07/13); binding to the real query surface is downstream.
- Each row is built so its detector stops firing exactly when the gap closes, so SIG-TASK-006 auto-invalidation and the closing condition are two views of the same fact.
- §33.2 is the count authority: `CATALOG_SIZE = 34` is asserted, not assumed.
